Terms

Claims must be made within 10 days of receipt. Returns need a return authorization number, and goods must come back in their original packing. Restocking fees apply to goods returned for credit. Seller's only obligation is to repair or replace product proved defective, and seller is not liable for any other loss. Prices do not include taxes, duties, or freight unless this document lists them. Late payments carry a charge of 1.5% a month.
